title: SourceConfig
description: Configures optional workflow settings and the language transformations used for formatting and statistics.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL used by editors.

leandir.description: Leandir path, resolved relative to this config file's directory.

languages.description: Enabled language domains and their settings. When omitted or empty, every registered language is enabled with its defaults.

ignore.description: Gitignore-compatible rules applied after ignoreFile rules. Paths are source-root-relative and use forward slashes.

ignoreFile.description: One or more gitignore-compatible files. Relative paths are resolved from this config file; files are loaded in array order.

humanFormatter.description: Formatter used when pulling supported AI-edited source. Type one uses stdin/stdout for one file per process; type all runs once and edits all supplied leandir files in place. Processes run in the source root with shell:false.

type.description: Whether to format one file through stdin/stdout or all changed files in place with one process.

command.description: Executable name or path; it is invoked directly with shell:false.

args.description: Arguments passed directly to the formatter. A standalone {file} is required for type one; a standalone {files} is required for type all and expands to separate argv entries.
